name: FIFTY! YEP!
label: Quest
description: FIFTY! YEP!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm going to let you in on a little secret, soldier. Come a little closer.
I'M THE ONLY SANE ONE HERE!
Look at these people! Would you believe that they're all insane!? Well they are! NUTS! CRAZY!
Let's just keep that between me, you, and my pal Captain Winky.
Anyhooooo... I'm collecting badges to go along with my ogre ear collection. Orc is the flavor of the day. Fifty. GO!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Burning Steppes to control, come in control.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done it! Your reward is: RUB MY BELLY! GO ON! RUB IT!
